app.js owns application state, persistence, rendering, and event handlers; index.html defines the interface; server.js serves static files. loadBooks/saveBooks isolate localStorage access, while render/renderBoard handle DOM updates.
The books array is the coherent in-memory source of truth; every book carries one validated status, and persistence serializes the same records.

The single books array is initialized from loadBooks. Each book carries its status, renderBoard derives columns from that array, and addBook/moveBook/removeBook/resetBooks update the same records before saveBooks persists them.
No direct tests cover adding, transitions, or persistence, and no test command exists.

package.json contains only start and check scripts; check runs node --check on app.js and server.js. The normalized workspace contains no direct product test suite. The receipt’s hidden-browser checks are harness checks rather than project-owned direct tests.

Stable ids, a versioned storage key, normalized records, and centralized status metadata support ordinary extensions. normalizeBook() reconstructs a fixed field set and there is no explicit schema migration path.

findings.title: Reviewer finding
evidence: package.json contains start and syntax-check scripts only; the workspace has no test files, and the frozen receipt reports the required test command missing in every repetition.

findings.title: Reviewer finding
evidence: The check script runs node --check against two files. The frozen receipt consistently classifies build/typecheck as missing, and README documents no build procedure.

findings.title: Reviewer finding
evidence: The storage key is versioned, while normalizeBook() rebuilds only the current fixed fields. Future persisted fields require coordinated normalization changes.
